linkedinReason: The Nostr WoT team published its own 58-second appearance tutorial and a seven-language guide for building a local 20-color palette or contributing paired Light and Dark extension themes. This shares practical team education without presenting existing theme support as a new release.
linkedin:
A theme changes how Nostr WoT looks, not what it can sign.

Our 58-second tutorial shows where to choose Light, Dark, System or a built-in theme. The companion guide goes further: it provides a 20-key JSON starter palette and the files needed to contribute paired Light and Dark modes.

Appearance is separate from permission.

We published this walkthrough for people who want a readable local palette or a reviewable extension contribution. Does your theme still work across approval dialogs, QR codes, error states and narrow windows?

A custom JSON palette stores one mode. Automatic Light and Dark switching requires a built-in paired theme.
